claims.text: Independent replay of Design/tests/test_e11_authority_gate.py at the canonical cwd (worktree root, HEAD c5fa2f8) exits 0 with 7/7 cases PASS and 0 bytes on stderr. Run by ARM-06, not by the author of 032d900.

CHECKLIST A.2 — the boss_stability deny assertion is discriminating: it FAILS (exit 1, named "*** FAIL ***" line) under negative control M1, which marks boss_stability A2-writable in a scratch copy of the registry, and PASSES under the canonical fixture (M0).
CHECKLIST A.3 — the world_tick deny assertion is discriminating: it FAILS under negative control M3 (world_tick marked YES) and PASSES under the canonical fixture.
CHECKLIST A.4 — boss_release_delay remains legitimately writable and the assertion is discriminating: it FAILS under negative control M2 (writability revoked) and PASSES under the canonical fixture.

DEFECT-1 — a2_writable() (test_e11_authority_gate.py:15-18) returns False on regex miss, so "explicitly denied in the registry" and "absent from the registry" are indistinguishable. Negative control M4 deletes the boss_stability row entirely and the gate still reports ALL GATE CONDITIONS MET at exit 0 — expected exit 1, actual exit 0.

DEFECT-2 — the regex captures the A2-writable cell by column POSITION. Negative control M5 inserts a third column into the §4.1 table; every cell then reads not-writable, so all five deny assertions pass VACUOUSLY and only the single boss_release_delay positive assertion fails. The deny assertions are load-bearing only while that one positive assertion sits beside them.

DEFECT-3 — test_e11_authority_gate.py:11 uses a cwd-relative path. Measured: exit 0 from the worktree root; exit 1 with 799 bytes of FileNotFoundError from Design/, Design/tests/, Source/ and /tmp. A breached gate at the canonical cwd ALSO exits 1. A runner reading only the exit code cannot distinguish a missing file from a breached authority gate.

SCOPE — the suite parses the markdown table at RX_SKILL_ENUMS_V1.md:289-296 and never executes product code. No E11 admission path exists in this worktree: rg over Source/ Schemas/ Data/ for adjust_counter, AdjustCounter, counter_threshold, CounterThreshold, AllowList and A2Writable exits 1 with no matches, and FRxSkillSpec (RxSkillSystem.h:77-85) is a six-field fixed-choice spec with no effect list. A.2/A.3/A.4 therefore prove THE REGISTRY DOCUMENT IS CORRECT AND ITS ASSERTIONS CAN FAIL. They do NOT prove that a validator rejects a player-authored E11 mutation, because there is no admission path to reject anything. The enforcement requirement at RX_SKILL_ENUMS_V1.md:261-266 is UNMET IN CODE.

CHECKLIST A.5 — whether C10 reads are unaffected is UNVERIFIED. No test exercising counter_threshold / C10 exists anywhere in this worktree, and per PRIME ruling no test was invented for it. This claim is OPEN, not satisfied.

Behavioural oracle first disposition: behavioural_oracle.py exits 0, RESULT PASS, 0 bytes on stderr. Canonical total_hp_lost measured at 560. The cycle-00 defect is confirmed by measurement: the bounds [1, 10_000_000] (behavioural_oracle.py:80-81) are ~17,857x the canonical value on the high side and admit the halved-damage value 428.

CORRECTION per PRIME ruling — the engine IS installed at /home/shax/Projects/UnrealEngine/UE-5.8 (Build.version 5.8.1, Build.sh executable, UnrealEditor-Cmd present). The RxOracleCommandlet blocker is therefore "the ReflexionArena module has never been built in this worktree" (no Binaries/, Intermediate/, Saved/), NOT "no usable engine on this box". My earlier claim named a search surface of /home/shax/UnrealEngine, /opt/UnrealEngine*, ~/Epic* and was stated more broadly than that surface supported.
